venue.body: Each asset is bought through the ONE pool pinned for it in AssetRegistry. Pools are never discovered at runtime.

price.body: The keeper supplies a same-block quote limit per asset; the router also rejects any fill outside the asset's oracle band.

waiting.body: While any active asset in your mix has a stale oracle (market closed) or a paused token, the keeper holds the WHOLE account: no leg is bought until every active leg can trade.

deferred.body: No quote, or a swap that reverts at sweep time: that leg's USDG goes back to the park untouched and is retried next epoch; the other legs still buy. A market condition never becomes a USDG payout.

delisted.body: If an elected asset is deactivated, it does not hold up the sweep: that leg is delivered to you as USDG with a notice (safe-settled).

fee.rate: {{fee}} on legs that actually convert — never on deferred or safe-settled legs.
fee.small: A small bps fee on legs that actually convert — never on deferred or safe-settled legs.

delivery.body: Bought tokens go straight to your account wallet. If a token refuses the transfer, it is held as a claimable balance in Spare Balance.

swept.allDeferred: Attempted in epoch #{{epoch}}, but every leg deferred ({{why}}): {{amount}} went back to the park and nothing was bought. Retried next epoch, in {{next}}.
swept.settled: Swept in epoch #{{epoch}}: {{settled}} settled. Eligible again in {{next}}.
swept.settledDeferred: Swept in epoch #{{epoch}}: {{settled}} settled, {{deferred}} deferred back to the park. Eligible again in {{next}}.
swept.plain: Swept in epoch #{{epoch}}; eligible again in {{next}}.
swept.checking: Swept in epoch #{{epoch}} — checking what filled…; eligible again in {{next}}.

engine.title: Sweep Engine

engine.hint: The keeper sweeps automatically — there is nothing to click. sweep() is keeper-only on-chain: once per epoch it takes every account whose parked spare has reached the threshold, splits it across that account's mix and buys each leg through its one allowlisted pool.

exit.readOnly: Only account {{account}} can exit — exit() pays whoever calls it. Connect that account to withdraw.
exit.confirm: Sends {{pending}} pending USDG to this wallet first, then redeems parked units to USDG — or hands them over in kind (e.g. SGOV) if they cannot be redeemed right now. Your rule and linked wallets are untouched, so new round-ups keep accruing unless you pause them.
exit.info: exit() cannot be paused, even if SPARE halts new activity. It does rely on the operator: one owner key (no multisig or timelock yet) controls the SPARE contracts and could redirect parked spare before you exit, so the park is only as safe as that key.

notes.why: Holdings must live as commitments in a pool, not a balance on a public account.

stealth.why: A sweep must land somewhere that cannot be linked back to a linked wallet.

key.why: The key that decrypts your own notes must be derived and reviewed before issue.

proof.why: The pool must prove it holds every share it owes without naming who owns what.

custody.why: Whoever holds the equities must accept settling against a shielded pool.

preview.title: Preview · not live
preview.body: Nothing is routed privately yet. Every sweep settles publicly to your wallet, and nothing in this window changes that.

hero.subtitle: Private path
hero.description: What a private path for sweeps would take. None of it is built: today every sweep settles publicly.

read.p1: The shielded-balance cryptography behind the private path <warn>is not built</warn>. No shielded pool is deployed, no viewing key has ever been issued, and no proof has been verified.
read.p2: The route switch below only changes the picture in this window. <info>It is not saved</info> and changes nothing on-chain.
read.p3: No viewing key is shown here, because none exists. A key that looks real but protects nothing would be saved, trusted and possibly reused. Once key derivation is audited and live, your key will come from the pool, not from this screen.

balance.title: Shielded balance
balance.head: No shielded pool · nothing to show
balance.body: No shielded pool is deployed, so there is no shielded balance to show. Your SPARE balance today is public and lives in Spare Balance: parked spare in CashPark and the stock tokens sweeps deliver to your wallet.

lanes.warn: Preview only. There is no private route yet: sweeps settle to your wallet in public.

a.title: Your data yours
a.body: Your tokenized equities sit in a pool as encrypted commitments instead of a balance anyone can read off an explorer. The pool's total is public; your slice of it is not.

b.title: Unlinkable wallet
b.body: Each sweep lands on a fresh one-time address, so watching a linked wallet does not reveal a running position — the single biggest leak in a transparent round-up product.

c.title: Read your own book
c.body: One read-only secret, held by you, that decrypts your own notes so you can audit your balance and history. Read-only: it cannot move funds. Sharing it hands someone permanent sight of your account, which is why it must never be issued casually — or by a mockup.

d.title: Proof of backing
d.body: Privacy for you, not for the operator. The pool publishes proofs that it holds every share it owes, so shielding your balance never means trusting an unaudited ledger.
